title: Kabocha Squash Tacos with Argentinian Salsa
description: A flavorful mexican dish featuring roasted kabocha squash and a tangy argentinian salsa, served in tacos with a crunchy golden topping.

ingredients.name: Argentinian Salsa
ingredients.notes: Homemade salsa with diced tomatoes, onions, jalapenos, cilantro, lime juice, and olive oil

ingredients.name: Golden Topping
ingredients.notes: Crushed tortilla chips with a sprinkle of cotija cheese

instructions: Cut the kabocha squash in half and scoop out seeds. Roast in the oven for 30 minutes, or until tender.
While the squash is roasting, grill the tortillas for a few minutes on each side, until slightly charred.
Dice the roasted squash and mix with the homemade argentinian salsa.
Warm the grilled tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the squash and salsa mixture onto a warmed tortilla, followed by a sprinkle of cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.
Top with crushed tortilla chips and a sprinkle of cotija cheese.
